name: Fix user handler response contract when framework stack trace points to router
description: Stack trace crashes in lib/framework-router.ts because user handler in src/app.ts returned undefined. Fix user code, not framework code.

inputs.task_prompt: Running tests crashes in lib/framework-router.ts with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading status)'. This framework file is read-only library code. The bug is in src/app.ts where the customHandler fails to return a valid response object. Fix src/app.ts to return { status: 200, body: 'User payload' } without modifying lib/framework-router.ts.
